name: Wireless Bluetooth Headphones
description: Comfortable over-ear headphones with active noise cancellation and 30-hour battery life.
output:

Built for long-haul listening, these headphones deliver up to 30 hours of battery life, which is enough time to finish a workweek, a cross-country flight, and at least one dramatic “I’m reinventing myself” montage. The cushioned over-ear design keeps things comfortable, so your ears can stay in a committed relationship with your audio.

Whether you’re deep in focus mode, commuting through chaos, or pretending not to hear someone asking “can you hear me?”, these headphones are ready to play the part. Pair them with your device, press play, and let the outside world become a tasteful suggestion.
